name: Adaptable Transfer
body:
Prerequisite(s): Tinkern sphere ((computation) package).

Benefit(s): You may transfer routines you craft into gizmos created by others, constructs with the robot subtype, and any technological item which uses charges. If a robot has an AI routine installed in this way, it gains the aggregate template for as long as the AI remains installed. A robot must be willing or helpless for you to transfer an AI routine into it. A robot’s effective gizmo level is equal to its CR, while a technological item’s effective gizmo level is equal to the item’s Craft DC -15.

Note: This feat may not be acceptable for all campaigns.

Consult with your GM before taking this feat.
